items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever - first of all, did you ever meet up with Sidney over there? ... PS: Yeah.

ctx.x: You can't tell who's better, they just blowing like hell, that's all. So's I'm not taking anything away from him, I'm not - but for me personally, I like the sound of Johnny in some things better because his tone was more purity for me. But he says himself that it's, he is the first inspiration. It's natural because Sidney's the first one, one of the first ones, to play, to pioneer in the damn soprano saxes. There's another little white boy that was all, that nobody never talks about but me as it seems, but maybe…
